csv_agency: Town of Orange Department Public Works
csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Orange is soliciting proposals from qualified consulting engineering firms to provide On-Call Professional Engineering Services for Transportation Projects on an as-needed basis during the performance period of this contract with Town of Orange (the "Town") entered into in pursuant to this Request for Proposals (this "RFP").

title: On-Call Professional Engineering Services
short_description: On-call engineering services for transportation projects in the Town of Orange, Virginia.
project_scope: On-call professional engineering services for transportation projects on an as-needed basis for the Town of Orange. The notice indicates a renewable contract with a 12-month base period and 48-month renewal option. Disciplines requested include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, cost estimating, inspection services, sanitation engineering, structural engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, stormwater, and traffic design engineering. No specific project, structure type, span, size, or construction quantities are defined.
services: On-call consulting engineering services for transportation projects, including civil, structural, geotechnical, surveying/GIS/mapping, cost estimating, inspection, hydrology/hydraulics, stormwater, sanitation, and traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style on-call services without a defined technical project scope.
- Target market is streets/highways, but no specific bridge or special structure is identified.
- Includes structural engineering among many disciplines, yet no concrete planning component for a notable structure is described.
- Such broad indefinite on-call contracts are generally low priority for sbp, especially without technical specification.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The notice is for an on-call professional services contract for unspecified future transportation projects, so no realistic project-specific construction cost can be derived from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. As this is an on-call multi-discipline services contract for undefined future assignments, a realistic sbp fee cannot be determined from the notice.
references_qualifications: Qualified consulting engineering firms are requested. Specific reference counts, project types, or qualification thresholds are not stated in the provided notice.
contracting_authority: Town of Orange, Department of Public Works, Orange, VA, USA. Contact: Deborah C. Sturm. Phone: 540-672-6917. Fax: 540-672-9250. Email: townplanner@townoforangeva.gov. Website: https://www.townoforangeva.gov/m/NewsFlash/Home/Detail/531
notes: Project number: RFP2026-01. Agency ID: 90055. Federal and state funding. Disabled Veteran Owned Business Enterprise participation goal noted. Pre-submittal meeting: 06/17/2026 02:00 PM EDT at 235 Warren St, Orange, VA 22960-1600, USA; attendance recommended. Questions due by 06/16/2026 04:00 PM EDT. Contract duration is renewable with 12-month base period and 48-month renewal option. Although structural engineering is listed, this appears to be a broad on-call transportation services framework rather than a defined bridge or building project.
